The Lost Prince is a companion to The Little Book ; whereas that was the story of Wheeler Burden in fin de siecle Vienna , this is the story of Eleanor Burden after her return from Vienna , up through the end of World War I . The Little Book was a compelling tale , and it provides the background necessary to make sense of The Lost Prince . I honestly do not know how this will read for people who have n't read The Little Book ; it may prove confusing or disjointed
